free_tier.stated: AGG Loop provides instant, highly secure localhost tunneling with zero config. 100% free forever with no bandwidth limits, fully backed by the Aeolink Group Inc. lab program.

egress.terms: No bandwidth throttles, no artificial session cuts, and no premium paywalls, per the launch text. No number is given.; ingress: http-only

interface_detail: A single terminal command, per the launch text; no syntax published.
tooling: Native CLI from the Loop-Client repository.
chaining: Nothing to chain while the product page is gone; if it returns, an HTTP-only edge.

limits.value: no bandwidth limit claimed; no number published

binding_note: If the no-limit claim held, nothing would bind on volume; the practical failure is protocol, since the edge is HTTP and WSS only.

identity_cost.detail: A CLI with zero config; no account, card or phone is mentioned in the launch text or the client repository.

reliability_note: Product page missing within six months of launch; the funding is described as a corporate lab program, which is the kind of backing that ends without notice.
confidence_note: The vendor's own product page at agglabs.com/loop returns 404 and the site root served nothing, so only the launch post and third-party write-ups support the claim.

evidence.proved: Launch on 2026-04-19; 100% free forever, no bandwidth throttles, no session cuts, funded by Aeolink Group; product acquired from Deposure.
404: the product page could not be found, and the site suggests it may be part of a product that has not launched.
Client maps local services to the AGG Labs edge over WebSocket Secure and native HTTP request processing.

notes: The strongest free-tier claim (no bandwidth limit at all) comes from a page that no longer exists six months after launch. A third-party review notes the vendor site said free for personal use while the launch said free forever. Treat the claim as unbacked until the product page returns.

extras.wg_detail: The client maps local services onto the AGG Labs edge using WebSocket Secure and native HTTP request processing, per the Loop-Client repository. No UDP listener is described.
extras.volume_stated: No bandwidth throttles, no artificial session cuts, and no premium paywalls, per the launch text. No number is given.
extras.transit_note: AGG Labs edge relays the traffic over WSS.
